summary.zh: 5 点让腐蚀术瞬发，再补命中与法力续航，连续拉怪也不用坐下喝水。
summary.en: Instant Corruption at five points, then hit and Mana sustain so you can chain pulls without drinking.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，用腐蚀术与生命分流刷任务
scenario.en: Levels 10–20, questing with Corruption and Life Tap

pros.zh: 强化腐蚀术去掉全部 2 秒施法时间并提高 10% 伤害，换目标的路上就能挂上腐蚀术。
pros.en: Improved Corruption removes the full 2-second cast and adds 10% damage, so Corruption goes up while you move between targets.

pros.zh: 强化生命分流让生命转化的法力多出 20%，术士因此可以完全跳过喝水。
pros.en: Improved Life Tap turns 20% more health into Mana, which is how a Warlock skips drink breaks entirely.

pros.zh: 镇压提供 3% 命中，并降低 12% 仇恨。
pros.en: Suppression adds 3% hit and cuts 12% of the threat you generate.

pros.zh: 灵魂收割点 1 点：带有吸取灵魂的目标死亡后，10 秒内法力回复提高 50%，施法时也保留一半回复。
pros.en: One point of Soul Harvest raises Mana regeneration by 50% for 10 seconds, and keeps half of it while casting, when something dies with Drain Soul on it.

pros.zh: 来源指南的正文与它自己的天赋图在镇压第 3 点上不一致；我们按正文处理，把 11 点全部用掉。不要这一点的话，可以改投 Improved Drains。
pros.en: The source guide's text and its own tree disagree on the third Suppression point; we follow the text, which spends all eleven. Skip it and the point is free for Improved Drains.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
